The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Tough. Precise. And built to outlast the competition.

From expansive commercial jobs to large property maintenance, Ferris zero-turn mowers are built to deliver premium performance and operator comfort. The IS700Z strikes the perfect balance of power, precision, and dependability, making it a favorite for commercial landscapers and property owners alike.

The new Ferris IS700-60, B27 delivers professional-grade results with a 60” fabricated iCD™ cutting deck, patented suspension system, and a 27 HP Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series engine. It’s designed to handle tough conditions efficiently without sacrificing ride quality.

Features may include:

Commercial Grade Power
Powered by a robust 27 HP Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series 8270 PXi V-Twin engine for exceptional reliability and output.

Suspension System
Patented Ferris suspension with front independent coil-over shocks and rear suspension system ensures a smoother ride and faster mowing.

Fabricated Cutting Deck
A heavy-duty 60″ iCD™ Cutting System delivers superior airflow, cut quality, and durability.

Hydro-Gear® Transaxles
Equipped with commercial-grade Hydro-Gear® ZT-3200™ drive system for responsive, smooth control and performance under load.

Adjustable Cut Height
Quick height-of-cut adjustment from 1.5” – 5.0” in 1/4” increments.

Ergonomic Operator Station
Features a high-back premium suspension seat with armrests and easy-access controls for all-day comfort.

Fuel Efficiency
8-gallon fuel tank extends mowing time and minimizes refueling interruptions.

Built to Perform
Engineered for performance in both commercial and demanding residential applications.
